messages:
Alex: heads-up — starting bring-up for hf:juno/juno-7b. int8 conversion finished but long-context ppl jumps ~18% vs fp16 on legal-doc set. suspect token id offset or rotary wrap. anyone seen this with juno variants? :thinking:
Mira: can you paste the conversion command + small sample diff? maybe tokenizer mapping dropped a pad/BOS shift.
Alex: converted with our usual script: `python convert.py --model juno-7b --quant int8 --out /tmp/juno_q`
Alex: quick log snippet:
```
conv: vocab_size=50280 -> wrote tokenmap.json
conv: rotary_dim=64 detected
conv: wrote weights int8 (symmetric)
smoke: eval ppl fp16=12.5 int8=14.8 (long-docs)
```
Sam: 18% is big. did you run tokenizer normalization check (NFKC) and special tokens mapping? sometimes HF naming mismatch causes +1 id shift.
Jordan: also check rotary base/scale parity — if rotary frequency table built with different head order you get phase misalign on long context; short prompts hide it.
Mira: Alex, can you dump first 16 token ids for a failing doc both fp16 and int8 inference?
Alex: posted here: `fp16_ids=[101, 234, 78, 9, ...]` vs `int8_ids=[102,234,78,9,...]` — looks like BOS moved by +1 on int8 run.
Li: BOS shift explains a consistent prefix mismatch and kvcache misalign. Was int8 runtime using a tokenizer wrapper? we had a bug where tokenmap loaded but index remapping not applied for streaming path.
Sam: ahh streaming path — that's `inference.stream_v2` which bypasses tokenmap for perf.
Alex: confirmed: running non-streaming int8 -> ppl matches fp16. streaming int8 causes +1.
quant-bot: auto-test results: streaming path failed tokenmap check (diff_count=1) on 5/6 samples. See job 4729.
Jordan: probable fix: apply tokenmap remap at both tokenizer output and at kvcache write/read. Otherwise kvcache keys drift.
Mira: quick patch suggestion — after tokenizer call do `ids = remap_token_ids(ids, tokenmap)` and assert `ids[0] == fp16_ids[0]` in smoke.
Alex: patch worked locally, streaming int8 ppl -> 12.6 (within noise). rolling a canary patch now.
Sam: follow-up: add unit to detect special token index shifts during conversion (compare hf tokenizer.vocab indices to tokenmap). Save as conversion invariant.
Li: also add explicit rotary headshape sanity check in model loader: compare expected rotary_dim/headcount to checkpoint meta and warn if mismatch.
Jordan: logging note — surface a short diff sample in console when ppl delta > 10% for long-context tests. Helps triage quickly.
Mira: filing a short RFC for conversion hardening and streaming path guardrails. assigning to Alex+Sam.
Alex: thanks all, will post canary results in ~30m. :thumbsup:
